prompt: What movie won the Teen Choice Award for "Choice Movie Liplock" the same year George W. Bush gave his "Mission Accomplished" speech?
answer: The movie was **_How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days_**. George W. Bush gave his “Mission Accomplished” speech in **2003**, the same year the film won the Teen Choice Award for **Choice Movie Liplock**.
